# Super Teacher Worksheets

> > Free printable worksheets and educational resources for elementary and middle school teachers covering math, reading comprehension, phonics, and more.

Super Teacher Worksheets provides thousands of printable PDF worksheets, games, and activities for K-8 educators. The site features comprehensive resources including Math Buzz daily review exercises, phonics materials, reading comprehension passages, and holiday-themed activities designed to support classroom instruction and skill retention.

## Key Topics

- Elementary Math Worksheets
- Reading Comprehension
- Phonics Instruction
- Math Buzz Daily Review
- Printable PDF Worksheets
- Addition & Subtraction
- Division & Multiplication
- Fractions & Decimals
- Money & Counting Coins
- Data Visualization & Graphing
- Hundreds Charts & Number Charts
- Holiday Educational Activities
- Teacher Resources
- Math Practice Games

## Reading & Literacy

- [4th Grade Reading Comprehension Worksheets](https://www.superteacherworksheets.com/4th-comprehension.html): 4th grade reading comprehension worksheets: fiction, non-fiction & poems
- [Phonics Worksheets: Full List](https://www.superteacherworksheets.com/full-phonics.html): Complete collection of phonics worksheets for elementary students

## Elementary Math: Addition & Subtraction

- [Basic Addition Worksheets](https://www.superteacherworksheets.com/addition-basic-index.html): Basic addition worksheets, games & activities for elementary math
- [Addition (Without Regrouping) Worksheets](https://www.superteacherworksheets.com/addition-no-regrouping.html): First grade addition worksheets without regrouping/borrowing

## Fractions, Money & Measurement

- [Comparing & Ordering Fractions](https://www.superteacherworksheets.com/comparing-fractions.html): Comparing & ordering fractions worksheets, task cards & games
- [Money Worksheets: Counting Coins & Making Change](https://www.superteacherworksheets.com/money.html): Money worksheets for counting coins & making change, K-4th grade

## Division Practice & Activities

- [Cootie Catcher Divide by FIVE](https://www.superteacherworksheets.com/printable-pdf-worksheets/division/20157-Cootie-Catcher-Divide-by-FIVE): Division by 5 cootie catcher game worksheet for grade 4
- [Cootie Catcher Divide by ELEVEN](https://www.superteacherworksheets.com/printable-pdf-worksheets/division/20163-Cootie-Catcher-Divide-by-ELEVEN): Division by 11 cootie catcher worksheet for grade 4 math practice
- [Division Timed Quiz 0 - 2](https://www.superteacherworksheets.com/printable-pdf-worksheets/division/20127-Division-Timed-Quiz-0-2): Division timed quiz worksheet for grade 4 math practice
- [Division Mystery Picture: Robot](https://www.superteacherworksheets.com/printable-pdf-worksheets/division/43140-Division-Mystery-Picture:-Robot): Division mystery picture robot worksheet for grade 4 math
